notes.title: New Library Native to Software
notes.notes:
Dear Munx Users!

Google will be discontinuing its library of 3D models (Poly) at the end of June 2021. We have been working hard to develop a library native to the software. In particular, we are doing our best to make sure that all the models you have downloaded will be kept and your memory palaces will remain intact.

As we are dealing with thousands of 3D models, it may be that one or two of the models you use will no longer be visible, or will be temporarily disabled. We suggest taking screenshots of your memory palaces before the end of the month just as a precautionary measure; and please let us know if any models are no longer appearing. If you have the screenshots, we can then potentially identify the missing models and get them working again.

If all goes to plan, you will not see any interruption, but we wanted to let you know about this major change. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We were blindsided by Google's announcement to discontinue Poly, and have had to build the library from the ground up. Thank you for your understanding.

For further details of updates and news on our planned improvements to the software, please see this video:

[previewyoutube=_5ahDokxaVQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Thank you,
Munx VR Team
